name: Randy Helvey
description: Discover, extract, build and log migrations in any Cendyn CMS module (rooms, offers, venues, events, blog, galleries, sections). Six skills: cendyn-discovery (maps a template into a reusable profile), cendyn-copy (extracts source copy with provenance tags), cendyn-page-builder (creates pages from profile + content), migration-log (one living record per site), photo-prep (fixes photos to under 20 MB / 5500 px, makes safe previews, and QA's client photo deliveries: spec, heroes, IA folders, SafeSpace, report) and skill-upgrader (turns recurring migration-log problems into approved skill fixes). Includes a hook that stops Claude opening oversized images, shared profiles and worked examples.
